Welcome to 'Explain It Like I'm Retarded'.

A few reasons. Eli5 is an Eddit clone, complete with the authoritarian rules and mods that don't give a shit about the users. I think the Elir title is a little more Voat-like.

Eli5 is also dead. The mods are gone and the community is not very engaged.

The concept behind the sub is one I've always enjoyed, so I would like to see an active version here. But one a little better focused on Voat users.

I wanted a relaxed atmosphere and rules. There is no need for subsections on rules. And no need for someone to be an authorised expert to provide an answer. If someone is wrong, someone else will correct them. Wrong answers can lead to further conversation and more people learning something. That can be a good thing.

So that's why I made it. Feel free to ask anything, but please avoid circlejerks and joke posts.

Please answer any questions you can in as simple a way as possible. Give supporting links if you feel they are needed, but they are not required unless someone calls out your answer as bullshit. Be prepared to provide links if that happens.

I will be adding css and flair, as well as a better sidebar and other stuff over the next few days. If anyone is interested in helping out and being a mod here let me know.
